error.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: The resubmitted content does not match
error.QUOTE_NOT_OFFERED: This quote was not offered in the conversation and cannot be booked
error.BOOKING_UNAVAILABLE: Booking is temporarily unavailable. Checking the result…
error.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: Service temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
error.FENCE_STALE: The system is busy. Please try again later.
error.INTERNAL: Internal system error. Please try again later.
error.CITY_AMBIGUOUS: The city name is ambiguous. Please be more specific.

error.TOOL_BUDGET_EXCEEDED: Too many steps in one run. Please rephrase and try again.
error.HANDS_UNAVAILABLE: Lookup service temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.

error.LLM_LENGTH: The answer was cut off. Please rephrase your question.
error.RESTART_LIMIT: The run was interrupted several times. Please try again.
error.CONTEXT_CORRUPT: The conversation context is broken. Please start a new chat.
